page.overview:
Who is Alman III?

Emperor Alman III was the tenth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 206 AG), succeeding his father Alman II as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Alman III ruled for less than a year before being succeeded by his brother Estil I.
